The discussion of gaining digital assets does not include an established guaranteed return, completed outcome, or required transfer of funds. The separate Trading 212 stock offer is explicitly disclosed as an affiliate promotion, and the available video evidence does not establish deception or connect it to the market-making discussion.

opening.argument: The presentation links a trading bot and market-making activity to acquiring more digital assets. It describes using Kelp to practice trades, then frames market making as a way to gain Zion Coins or XLM. That is a concrete participation-for-return pathway, not merely neutral software education. The description also promotes using AMM processes to make “optimal trades” with XLM, while the title presents “trillion” scale. Viewers are therefore encouraged to connect deploying or using the trading workflow with substantial upside, even though no evidence demonstrates that such gains occur.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the material “practice” does not remove the commercial promise. The same discussion moves from using the bot to making markets and gaining assets, while the title foregrounds trillion-scale money. The instability disclaimer addresses software reliability, not whether viewers are being steered toward a potentially profitable trading activity.

opening.argument: Several unusually attractive financial signals are presented together: a “FREE STOCKS WORTH UP TO £100,” a referral code, and a promise that both parties receive a free share. The description directs viewers to create an investment account and use the supplied code. Alongside that low-barrier reward, it places crypto purchase and wallet links and promotes trillion-scale AMM possibilities. The combination makes the content function as a solicitation for account creation and financial participation, regardless of whether every individual offer is technically disclosed.

The description says buying Zioncoins means acquiring something “special,” invites viewers to learn how to buy them, and supplies a purchase route. It then links AMM activity to optimal XLM trades and uses a headline promising trillions via AMM. That framing turns technical discussion into promotional encouragement to acquire tokens and participate in their market, with upside emphasized more strongly than independently verifiable results.
